Sarah Brager / San Francisco Chronicle :

 A US federal grand jury indicts OpenAI engineer and Saudi national Abdulrahman “Abdul” Alfozan on a felony charge of interception of oral communications   —  The OpenAI engineer accused of bugging a conference room in San Francisco used by company executives was indicted Tuesday, according to a court filing.
